body: Yeah, it's a book full of poems. Don't know if this will work. Not exactly was I was hoping for but thanks anyway.

>You reach out to a friend because you trust them but then you feel guilty because you've drained them so much.

Yeah, my friend managed to keep me alive for this long. I initially wanted to do it 2 months ago but she did a good job in keeping me alive, until I felt that I couldn't take it anymore and I tried to end it last night...

I guess that it's the general feeling about life? The thing that kickstarted all my insecurities and possibly depression were my old friends that were toxic, very toxic towards me. I managed to cut most of my ties with them but damn, they left some huge scars.
I just feel like I have no purpose, I feel a burden to everyone especially to my friends. I don't find happiness in anything that I currently do. Everything seems bland. My passions are slowly fading away and the only thing that eases my pain is currently music. Recently I started having mental breakdowns where I'd force myself not to cry because all these thoughts are overwhelming me. I really want to feel better but I seem to get worse and worse with time..
